svg.title: Three panels, each with the same target, the same starting point and the same clock, so only the shape of the motion can differ. In the first the crosshair flicks out past the target and comes back, and its trail loops out above the line and returns below it. In the second it covers most of the distance quickly and then inches the last short stretch, so its trail dots crowd together just short of the target. In the third the motion is ordinary but the shot mark falls early, while the crosshair is still short of the target and still settling. Every dot is one tick of the shared clock, so where the dots crowd the crosshair was slow.

text.tspan: out past the target, then back
most of the way fast, the rest a crawl

svg.text: One clock for all three. The dots crowd where the crosshair was slow.
